page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr8i.large is a virtual machine instance within the High Clock Speed family, configured for tasks requiring high CPU clock frequencies paired with elevated memory capacity. Hosted on the KVM hypervisor, this instance provides 2 dedicated vCPUs driven by an Intel Xeon 6462C x86_64 processor clocked at a baseline frequency of 3.3 GHz. The hardware architecture couples these dedicated processing cores with 16.0 GB of system memory, yielding an 8.0 GB per-core memory ratio.

The instance does not include integrated local disk storage, requiring external cloud block storage for operating system installation and persistent data storage. It provides a baseline network throughput of 2 Gbps and comes with zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses, necessitating external routing configurations or elastic IPs for public internet connectivity. There are no discrete GPU accelerators attached, keeping hardware resources concentrated on general compute and memory tasks.

With its 3.3 GHz dedicated Intel Xeon cores and an 8:1 memory-to-core ratio, ecs.hfr8i.large is structured for workloads that demand both fast single-thread execution and substantial per-thread memory. It offers qualitative cost efficiency by allowing memory-heavy applications to run without having to purchase surplus vCPUs. Suitable workloads include in-memory databases, Redis caching layers, memory-sensitive backend services, and lightweight batch analytics.
